column2: [intro]
One day, I was on the football field
I wasn't very good, I admit
But I had this growing strength inside me
Even if technically I'm not the best
In sports, you don't just need to be strong
It's the mental game that makes the difference, it's crazy!
When you fight on the field like a hero
It's the mental game that makes you invincible, takes you higher
I tried tennis, I wasn't very good
But mentally, I was a champion
I threw the racket, I smiled
Because in my head, I always have the victory
In sports, the mental game is the secret weapon
It's the fire that burns all defeat
When you believe in it, nothing can stop you
The mental game makes you win, makes you exist
[ solo ]
